description:
Read current RS3 catalogue records or compare candidate snapshots. Resolve names with lookup_item; use get_price_series for dated history and estimate_flip for profit calculations.

- records reads Jagex identity, examine/type/membership, icon URLs and guide prices. itemId=4151 means Abyssal whip. Arrays always return results[] in caller order, including errors at failed IDs, even for one entry.
- includeLiveData adds reported trades and numeric Wiki facts without replacing guide fields. Trades are not executable offers; buy limits are not remaining quota.
- comparison reads compact Weirdgloop daily price/volume snapshots for itemIds in caller order. Missing metrics remain absent and unresolved IDs become error rows. It does not rank the whole GE.
- Record batches retain successful rows and error if all fail. At most two reads run concurrently; 429 stops queued reads. Invalid selectors fail before fetching.
- Guide/comparison reads are uncached and lag activity. Trades cache for 30 seconds and facts for 10 minutes; cache hits preserve fetchedAt. No credentials are required. HTTP defaults to 60 requests/IP/minute; wait for Retry-After after 429.
